description: Full details of one OLX.pl offer: price (or salary for a job), every attribute with its Polish name and value (area, rooms, rent, condition, model, year, mileage…), the full description, all photo URLs, location (city, district, voivodeship, map coordinates — often approximate), seller type and public name (company, or the first name a private seller shows), posting/refresh/expiry times, OLX delivery availability, and the original otodom.pl link for partner property listings. No contact details. Fetched live from OLX.pl's public API (typically well under 1 s; a few seconds when it falls back to an unblocker). Result: { source, fetchedAt, offer: { id, url, title, status, category_id, category, price, salary?, area_m2?, rooms?, params: [{ key, name, value }], description, location: { city, city_id, district, district_id, region, region_id, lat, lon, approximate }, seller: { type, name, member_since }, created_time, refreshed_time, valid_to_time, promotion, olx_delivery, photos, external_url } }.

id.description: The offer's numeric id (e.g. 1100381308) or its OLX URL (…-CID3-ID1ct5rC.html), as returned by olx_search.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

name: olx_offer
title: Get one OLX.pl offer
